tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and panel background (the 'cup'). Light theme is Latte, dark is Espresso.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, the toolbar tile behind command icons.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: viewport preview frames, slider tracks, code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panel sections. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, sliders and secondary buttons (3:1 against surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the 'zero isoline' outline on illustrations. 13:1 on surface (light), 15:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, units after numbers. ≥5:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: espresso
tokens.usage: The deepest brand brown. Logo outlines, sticker shadows. In dark theme it is a fill on light chips only, never on the page.

tokens.name: mocha
tokens.usage: The drink. Secondary brand fill; legible as text on surface in both themes (≥5:1).

tokens.name: caramel
tokens.usage: Primary brand fill: primary buttons, active toggles, slider fill, the 'outside' of a distance field. Not a text colour on light surfaces (2.3:1) — use caramel-ink.

tokens.name: on-caramel
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a caramel fill (5.8:1). Never white on caramel.

tokens.name: caramel-ink
tokens.usage: Caramel as text: links, active tab labels, the 'FRep' in running copy. ≥4.5:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: latte
tokens.usage: Soft tint: selected rows, the cup sleeve, hover fills, secondary badge backgrounds.

tokens.name: whip
tokens.usage: Whipped-cream white for illustration highlights and the lid. Not a page colour.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: The straw. Playful accent for 'new' and highlights; one per view.

tokens.name: berry-ink
tokens.usage: Berry as text (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Iced blue: the 'inside' (negative distance) of a field and selection fills in the viewport.

tokens.name: ice-ink
tokens.usage: Ice as text and the focus ring (5.6:1 light, 11:1 dark).

tokens.name: matcha
tokens.usage: Success fill: 'Order up' toasts, finished meshes.

tokens.name: matcha-ink
tokens.usage: Success text (≥5.3:1).

tokens.name: cherry
tokens.usage: Errors and invalid fields only (text and borders, ≥4.5:1). Never decorative.

tokens.name: field-outside
tokens.usage: Positive distance (outside the shape) in field previews and contour bands.

tokens.name: field-inside
tokens.usage: Negative distance (inside the shape) in field previews.

tokens.name: field-zero
tokens.usage: The f(p)=0 isoline — the actual surface — drawn as a 2px line over field previews.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ring with a 2px surface gap.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Splash, about box, hero. One per surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles in docs and marketing.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles (the café name of a command).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Blends two fields with a rounded fillet of radius k.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Ctrl + click to type a value

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels above controls; set in uppercase.

styles.name: command
styles.usage: Rhino command names, anywhere they appear.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Live numeric read-outs next to sliders and in status lines (tabular figures).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; toolbar icon gutter.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding; row gap in property lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding (Rhino side panels are narrow: don't exceed this).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panel sections; card padding in docs.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters in docs and marketing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero spacing only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, the 16px icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, toolbar tiles. The default blend k.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, popovers, field preview frames.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Splash cards and the app-icon tile (scaled: 58/256 of the icon).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Size picker (Tall / Grande / Venti), toasts, slider thumbs.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: The signature hard offset shadow under primary buttons and pressed-able tiles. Pair with a 2px ink border.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers and toasts that float over the Rhino viewport.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, inactive control borders.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Outline weight of 24px command icons (scale with the icon).

tokens.name: stroke-sticker
tokens.usage: The ink border on primary buttons, toasts and illustrations — the zero isoline.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items and the tiny app icon.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Rhino toolbar command icons (default).

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Large toolbar buttons, panel title icon.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, size picker.
